newsitem.title: INDIA: BT in major India investment - executives.
newsitem.headline: BT in major India investment - executives.

text.p: British Telecommunications Plc is to announce on Friday a major investment in a joint venture with an Indian cellular telephone partner, executives familiar with the agreement said.

"British Telecom is announcing it is increasing its investment in India through a tie-up with a new Indian partner in cellular telephony," an executive told Reuters. "It is a major investment," he said without elaborating.
The executives, who were involved in planning the announcement of the the deal, did not reveal the size of the investment or the name of the Indian partner.
British Telecom chairman Iain Vallance and the firm's managing director for India, Arun Seth, had scheduled a news conference for 3:30 p.m. (1000 GMT) on Friday in the Indian capital.
Vallance was one of more than 50 senior business executives accompanying British Prime Minister John Major on a week-long visit to India, Bangladesh and Pakistan.
Major, who began his trip in Calcutta on Thursday, was scheduled to fly to the southern city of Bangalore with Prime Minister H.D. Deve Gowda later on Friday.
